_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in low-conviction drift near the Complacency ceiling with the bottom analog diverging, so the rung holds rather than breaks until flows or F&G decide.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD into Complacency; narrative is descriptive (outflow widen) with no explicit phase/direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays inside 47-54 and 30d momentum holds the low-40s with price continuing to chop rather than trend
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below 46 with momentum_30d under 35 and ETF flows still dead (down into Anxiety), or ETF flows reverse sharply higher with momentum back above 55 (up into Disbelief)
